values.value: Finance book has no open period for today

Finds: Active blng__FinanceBook__c records with no blng__FinancePeriod__c covering today's date. Why it matters: Postings dated today can't find an open period — they either reject (operational stall during month-end) or post to a default bucket that finance has to reconcile manually. Catastrophic during close week. Suppress a finding: only during a brief planned cutover between fiscal years where overlap is being managed manually. Disable the detector: only if your org doesn't use Salesforce Billing finance books. Most billing customers should leave this on.
